ABCA2 up-regulation in a mitoxantone-resistant SCLC cell line was associated with increased mitoxantron accumulation.
the ABCA2 transporter gene was upregulated in mitoxantronedrug resistant small cell lung cancer cells and this was associated with increased resistance to mitoxantrrone and estramustine.
ABCA2 overexpression is responsible for mitoxantronic resistance and estramustine reverses this resistance.

the identification of ABCA2 as a novel factor involved in mitoxantrrone resistance.
the identification of factors that are associated with the resistance of mitoxanrtrone.
the identification of a novel resistance factor for mitoxantron in small cell lung cancer cells.

ABCA2 is not involved in mitoxantron resistance, but is involved in estramustine resistance.
ABCA2 is not a direct efflux pump for mitoxantron, but that it is involved in the resistance of mitoxantron.
ABCA2 is involved in mitoxantrrone resistance in GLC4 cells.

ABCA2 up-regulation is associated with mitoxantrones resistance and ABCA2 overexpression is associated with ABCB1 upregulation.
